deploy.surface: the owner's own Windows 11 machine only; no hosted component
deploy.binary: src-tauri/target/release/reviewglass.exe of the main checkout, launched from Desktop and Start Menu shortcuts; the build agent pulls and rebuilds it after every merge and verifies on warm launches; 30.9.2026: rebuilt from main 37d4a8d (adr.rg.030 amended twice) and launched through Explorer
deploy.collector: ~/.reviewglass/bin/reviewglass-statusline.exe (statusLine) and ~/.reviewglass/bin/reviewglass-hook.exe (PostToolUse), both configured in ~/.claude/settings.json (backups: settings.json.bak-reviewglass-p0, -p4); the spool they write is ~/.reviewglass/spool (sessions/, events/) — never under AppData (adr.rg.019)
deploy.installers: NSIS and MSI both build; not yet used — P7
deploy.atlas: system reviewglass; status via atlas_put_status; MCP worker redeployed manually after each model merge (CI only dry-runs)

workflow: Code and docs in English, conversation in Finnish. cargo fmt + clippy -D warnings + cargo test + pnpm check before every commit; CI on windows-latest runs the same. Commit straight to main while the repo is single-author (public since 17.9.2026); the Atlas model changes go through a PR on the Atlas repo, then wrangler deploy of the MCP worker. A new decision enters the Atlas model first and is rendered into docs/adr/ by node scripts/adr-from-model.mjs. End a session by updating docs/CHANGELOG.md, docs/BUILD_INFO.json and, if a lesson was learned, docs/LESSONS.md; put the status to Atlas.
